text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the Tracen Academy student
council is
holding a holiday party for the
student body.

text_block_list.name: Helios and Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Happy, happy holidays! ☆
Let's get this
party started!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-i-i-it's like this whole party is a present just for me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All the academy's top Umas crowded
together in one place! Almost brushing
up against me—hhhggggk! I feel like the
gods might smite me for simply being
here and breathing the same air...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Sorry for the wait, everyone!
Let's get
this present swap started!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Take the gift you brought and shuffle it
in with the rest. Afterwards, take a
different one for
yourself! Hope you all
get a good one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! I want that one... and this one...
and that
one too. I want 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After nearly racking my brains to the
point of failure, I settled on this one.
Hehe. Of course, I'll
treasure it forever,
no matter who it's from.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I mean, getting a present from one of my
precious
Umas... It's like I'm already in
heaven.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention I get to do all this with
my mega
simp trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital couldn't be happier. At
last, it's
time to open the presents.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ready, everyone? We're all gonna open
our gifts
at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one... Open!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital tears open the wrapping
paper and
opens the box inside to
reveal...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A calculator... I got a calculator!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! Never in my wildest
dreams
would I—ohoohoohoooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not especially. But if it's from an Uma,
how could
I not be thrilled?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can use it to keep my stats straight
when I'm
calculating Uma fic ideas
before bed. I wonder
who it's from...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That would be me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Of course it would be you. A calculator is such a Shakur gift. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think it'd go to someone who
joined the academy the same time as me.
The odds of you
getting my gift were
barely over one percent...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's some kismet at work.
If that's
the case, I have another present
to go along with
the first.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? A bonus?! Are you a goddess
in the
flesh? Um, may I ask what it is?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh, sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's a challenge. You and me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shakur?! But... you've never shown
any interest
in me before...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Before" being the key word. That all
changed
after I saw you run this year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Your performance isn't affected by track
type...
I'm curious to see how that works.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It's wild I never noticed there
was
someone this interesting in my own
gen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you out for some partner
running, so
lemme collect your data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! Am I dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Amaterasu has finally stepped out from
her cave!
The whole world is bathed in
light!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, hold on one second, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Digital is a very valuable resource in my
ongoing
experiments. You can't just
borrow her whenever
you please.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why, you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's roommate, Agnes
Tachyon, pokes
her head into the
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Back off. This's got nothin' to do
with you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I refuse. Digital is mine, thank you. As
her
roommate, I reserve the preferential
rights to her
usage.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you're some kinda big shot
just 'cause
you've known her longer.
She's comin' with me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-what's happening?! I'm sure
there's
been some misunderstanding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This is... the taboo-iest of taboos. The two of them... and me caught in the middle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... A gust of wind could knock me
over...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital seems delighted to have
so many
Umamusume showing interest in
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's an... autograph book...
And it's got a
bunch of
—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaa?! It has everyone's autograph?! Omigarrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what a gem! An heirloom!
No—an
indisputable national treasure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This would go for no less than a million 
Umapoints at auction. How in the world
did such
an astounding item fall into my
lap?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm pleased to see you like it, Agnes
Digital.
Everyone prepared this gift
together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: P-P-P-President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You've won over countless Umamusume
fans with
your eclectic running style.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Consequently, our appeal is broader and
more impactful than before. The
contribution you've made to Tracen
Academy is of great weight and
merit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We initially considered giving you an
official commendation, but you have
rather more... idiosyncratic preferences,
if I recall correctly.
Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We figured you might be happier with a
gift of
this sort. Think of it as a modest
symbol of our
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-o-omg I just asdhjkhkAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Fuji and Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Doto and Urara
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Waaaah... Trainer... Trai—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAGGGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I can see... the gates of Paradise...
opening
before me...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A long cry of pure joy resonates through
the sky on this festive night. It is the
most blissful celebration that Agnes
Digital has ever
experienced.
